caption: The drawing depicts a wooden music stand with a brown hue, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The stand features a slanted, rectangular platform, likely designed for holding sheet music or a book, with a small ledge at the bottom to keep items from sliding off. Attached above the platform is an irregularly shaped, vertical wooden piece with a rough, uneven top edge. The stand is supported by a single, vertical post that extends downward, culminating in a base with three ornate, curved legs. The drawing is rendered in a realistic style with fine shading to suggest the texture and grain of the wood. The background is otherwise empty, except for the name "ALBERT PRATT" printed in uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Music Stand
